resolved_conflicts.explanation: The lookout was registered in 2009 while it still stood; the Wallow Fire destroyed it in 2011

notes_for_editor: Four sources agree on the 1933 CCC build and the 2011 Wallow Fire loss; the register says June 2011 and the Knoll history says June 4, 2011, which is consistent. A search snippet from a Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook post says an earlier Big Lake lookout stood in the early 1900s; that post could not be read, so it is not in the story and needs checking. The azmemory.azlibrary.gov Wallow Fire record returned HTTP 403 and was not used. Site condition since 2011, any remains, and public access are not described in any source read. Record status 'gone', kind 'tower' and built 1933 match the sources; no corrections proposed.
